children: Four new addresses accumulated 31,979 ETH after the broader market pulled back last night, according to on-chain analyst Ai Yi (@ai_9684xtpa). According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the addresses withdrew ETH from a centralized exchange between 11:31 p.m. and 11:38 p.m. last night.
The four addresses are suspected to belong to the same whale or entity. They withdrew ETH worth $85.68 million from a centralized exchange at an average price of $2,679.31.

title: Four New Addresses Accumulate 31,979 ETH After Market Pullback
